text: rwb-case publishes rwb.case.ParameterVersionApproved.v1 on rwb.case.events.v1 through the outbox as a CloudEvents envelope whose payload carries paramKeys, versionNo, validFrom and environment, with no personal data and no secret value; every instance refreshes on the event through the inbox library and at the latest at the cache time to live, and if the catalogue review refuses the event the time to live remains the only refresh.
why: AC1, AC8 and AC11 need a refresh without a restart and the legacy story names the event, but the rwb-case event catalogue has no row for it, so the contract element needs a default.

text: A service reads the catalog at GET /api/recovery/case/v1/admin/parameters with a key-prefix query and a service identity holding Rules and parameters R, one hop with a 2 s timeout and a breaker, answered with valueInForce, versionNo and validFrom per key and cached per environment to config.cache.ttl-seconds (60, assumed; DL11); its start-up check fails its health check with MSG-P3-032 when a required key has no value and no default, no service reads parameter_catalog or parameter_value, and a load row carries the three columns key, environment and value.
why: AC3 and AC4 test the check in a consuming service and the legacy in-process interface disappears across the service boundary, but no source gives the operation, the right or the keys artefact a service uses.
